title: Implement secret handle lease rules for Agent runtime
purpose: Extend the MVP handle-only secret policy into concrete runtime rules for planning, memory, audit, and execution.
scope: Define SecretHandle metadata allowed in PlanSpec, Observation, Memory, and Audit.
Define forbidden secret value paths: model context, planner output, memory entries, audit summaries, CLI projection, and TUI projection.
Define secret-use capability lease with narrow tool, actor, resource, expiry, and one-shot semantics.
Add helper boundary placeholder for future keyring or narrow helper resolution.
Redact secret-like values while preserving secret://handle references.
Audit secret handle use without revealing values.
deliverables: Secret redaction and handle validation tests
acceptance_criteria: secret://handle references remain visible where needed.
Raw secret-like values are rejected or redacted before model, memory, and audit summaries.
Secret-use requires an explicit capability lease.
Secret-use cannot be granted by broad approval tokens.
Secret fixtures remain covered by safety gate.
verification: Run redaction tests for token/password/key patterns.
Attempt to place secret value into memory and confirm rejection or redaction.
Inspect audit output for handle-only behavior.
risk_notes: Secrets are a runtime concern, not a logging concern; every module boundary must preserve handle-only behavior.
implementation_steps: Define SecretHandle metadata without raw secret values.
Define one-shot SecretUseLease with actor, tool, resource, purpose, expiry, and consumption state.
Reject raw secret values in PlanSpec, Observation, Memory, audit summary, CLI projection, and TUI projection.
Preserve secret://handle references through redaction and summaries.
Reject broad approvals such as all secrets or any credential.
Audit secret handle use without revealing the value.
failure_modes: Raw token, password, API key, or bearer credential appears in serialized runtime surfaces.
One-shot secret lease can be reused or used after expiry.
Secret handle identity is lost during redaction.
Model context, memory, audit, CLI, or TUI receives raw secret values.

verification_matrix.expected: secret redaction, handle preservation, and broad-approval rejection tests pass
handle metadata, lease use, expiry/reuse, and audit tests pass
secret handling does not regress audit or memory behavior

blocked_until: Raw values are rejected or redacted from all runtime surfaces.
